title: CWP/16119/2025 of NARESH TANWAR AND OTHERS Vs STATE OF HARYANA  AND OTHERS
judge: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANUPINDER SINGH GREWAL
text:
SONIA GUGNANI 2025.08.01 10.02 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 165 CWP-16119-2025 Date of decision : 30.07.2025 Naresh Tanwar and others ... Petitioners Versus State of Haryana and others ... Respondents CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANUPINDER SINGH GREWAL HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPAK MANCHANDA Present:- | Mr. Munish Mittal, Advocate for the petitioner. Mr. Deepak Bhardwaj, Addl.A.G., Haryana. Mr. Ankur Mittal, Advocate, Ms. Kushaldeep Kaur, Advocate, Ms. Ashna Singh, Advocate and Ms. Saanvi Singla, Advocate for the respondent/HSVP. aK Anupinder Singh Grewal, J. (Oral) The petitioners have challenged the advertisement/public notice dated 05.04.2025 (Annexure P-13) which had been issued without mentioning any plot of Sector 21-D, Faridabad under oustee category.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that although the land of the petitioners was acquired for development of a residential Sector-21D, Faridabad but the respondents vide the impugned advertisement had not published any plot under the oustee quota in that Sector. He also submits that the petitioners have applied under the impugned advertisement (Annexure P-13) and the respondents be directed to consider their claim as per their eligibility under the Policy. Chandigarh

3. Issue notice to the respondents.

4. At the asking of the Court, Mr. Deepak Bhardwaj, Addl.A.G., Haryana, accepts notice on behalf of respondent No.1.

5. Mr. Ankur Mittal, Advocate has put in appearance on behalf of respondents No.2 to 4 and submits that the petitioners have applied for allotment of plot in pursuance to the aforenoted advertisement and their applications would be considered in accordance with law.

6. Heard.

7. We are of the considered view that although the land of the petitioners may be situated in Sector 21-D, Faridabad but it is not necessary for the respondents/HSVP to put plots in the same sector to auction. Therefore, there is no illegality in the action of the respondents in issuance of advertisement for allotment of plots in several other Sectors of Faridabad. The petitioners have applied for allotment in that sectors which is being considered by the respondents.

8. Consequently, the petition is disposed of with a direction to the respondents to consider the application(s) of the petitioners for allotment of plots in terms of their policy. (ANUPINDER SINGH GREWAL) JUDGE (DEEPAK MANCHANDA) JUDGE July 30, 2025 sonia gugnani SONIA GUGNANI 2025.08.01 10.02 Chandigarh
